[[Confessor Isaiah]] is the leader of the [[White Mantle]] during the [[War in Kryta]]; he is responsible for the deployment of the [[Peacekeeper]]s and the [[White Mantle inquisition|Inquisitor]]s. He rose from his position as a [[Justiciar Isaiah|Justiciar]] after the death of [[Confessor Dorian]].
